database_schema.summary: Cloud Firestore stores user favorites under /users/{userId}/userdata/favorites as a map of station IDs to timestamps. IDs match 1:1 with VinFast locationId.
database_schema.relationships_explained: Each user owns exactly one favorites document at /users/{userId}/userdata/favorites. Station locationId in Firestore is 100% compatible with both VinFast CAPP API and evcs.vn.

api_endpoints.name: VinFast Station Search
api_endpoints.auth: CAPP Headers (X-APP-VERSION: 2.25.7, X-SERVICE-NAME: CAPP, X-Device-Platform: android) + optional Bearer
api_endpoints.purpose: Search nearby VinFast charging stations by lat/lon

api_endpoints.name: VinFast Location Info
api_endpoints.purpose: Query batch real-time plug status & EVSE counts for locationIds

api_endpoints.name: EVCS Search (Tier 2 Fallback)
api_endpoints.auth: HMAC-SHA256 signature with EVCS app secret
api_endpoints.purpose: Automatic fallback query if VinFast primary API fails or returns 401

features: VinFast CAPP Direct API Integration with Dual-Tier Fallback (VinFast -> EVCS)
Strict EV Car Port Filtering (Excludes 3.5kW / 7kW bike plugs, retains 11kW AC and 30kW - 360kW DC)
Native Station Detail Bottom Sheet with VinFast S3 Photo Carousel and Lightbox Zoom
Local-First Firestore Favorites Sync with Anonymous & 1-Tap Google Sign-In
Direct CDN Media URL Decoding (Bypassing Cloudflare HTTP 403)

patterns: Dual-Tier Repository Pattern: Primary direct CAPP API -> Fallback proxy (evcs.vn HMAC-SHA256 signed)
Port Filtering Pipeline: Filter out connectors where type <= 7000 to keep EV car bays exclusively
URL query parameter separation for VinFast search (page/size in query string, lat/lon in body)
Double-layer base64 URL decoding to resolve direct cpo-prod-s3 image URLs
Firestore Map structure favorites.[stationId] for atomic add/delete
gotchas: VinFast locationId is identical to evcs.vn station ID; no Firestore migration needed
VinFast CAPP requires X-APP-VERSION: 2.25.7, X-SERVICE-NAME: CAPP, X-Device-Platform: android headers
VinFast CAPP endpoint returns 401 Unauthorized without bearer token, triggering seamless Tier 2 fallback
evcs.vn /media endpoint blocks requests with Cloudflare 403; decode double base64 to cpo-prod-s3 directly
